start.lib/settings.rb:
# frozen_string_literal: true

module Settings
  ROOT = File.expand_path('../config', __dir__)
  LOCKED = [].freeze
  LAYERS = ['defaults', 'environ', 'cli', 'stage'].freeze # lowest priority first

  def self.read_ini(path)
    values = {}
    return values unless File.exist?(path)

    section = ''
    File.readlines(path).each do |raw|
      line = raw.split('#', 2).first.to_s.strip
      next if line.empty?

      if line.start_with?('[')
        section = line[1..-2].strip
        next
      end
      key, value = line.split('=', 2)
      values["#{section}.#{key.strip}"] = value.strip
    end
    values
  end

  def self.from_environ(known)
    known.keys.each_with_object({}) do |name, found|
      var = 'APP_' + name.tr('.', '_').upcase
      found[name] = ENV[var] if ENV.key?(var)
    end
  end

  def self.from_cli(argv)
    found = {}
    i = 0
    while i < argv.length
      if argv[i] == '--set' && i + 1 < argv.length
        key, value = argv[i + 1].split('=', 2)
        found[key] = value
        i += 1
      end
      i += 1
    end
    found
  end

  def self.load(argv)
    env = ENV.fetch('APP_ENV', 'dev')
    defaults = read_ini(File.join(ROOT, 'defaults.ini'))
    sources = {
      'defaults' => defaults,
      'site' => read_ini(File.join(ROOT, 'site.ini')),
      'stage' => read_ini(File.join(ROOT, "#{env}.ini")),
      'local' => read_ini(File.join(ROOT, 'local.ini')),
      'environ' => from_environ(defaults),
      'cli' => from_cli(argv)
    }
    merged = {}
    LAYERS.each do |layer|
      sources[layer].each do |key, value|
        next if LOCKED.include?(key) && ['environ', 'cli'].include?(layer)

        merged[key] = value
      end
    end
    merged
  end
end

module Settings
  ROOT = File.expand_path('../config', __dir__)
  LOCKED = ['log.level'].freeze
  LAYERS = ['defaults', 'process_env', 'local', 'cli', 'shared', 'env'].freeze # lowest priority first

  def self.read_ini(path)
    values = {}
    return values unless File.exist?(path)

    section = ''
    File.readlines(path).each do |raw|
      line = raw.split('#', 2).first.to_s.strip
      next if line.empty?

        next
      end

      values["#{section}.#{key.strip}"] = value.strip
    end
    values
  end

  def self.from_environ(known)
    known.keys.each_with_object({}) do |name, found|
      var = 'APP_' + name.tr('.', '_').upcase
      found[name] = ENV[var] if ENV.key?(var)

  end

  def self.from_cli(argv)
    found = {}
    i = 0
    while i < argv.length
      if argv[i] == '--set' && i + 1 < argv.length
        key, value = argv[i + 1].split('=', 2)
        found[key] = value
        i += 1
      end
      i += 1
    end
    found
  end

  def self.load(argv)
    env = ENV.fetch('APP_ENV', 'staging')
    defaults = read_ini(File.join(ROOT, 'defaults.ini'))
    sources = {
      'defaults' => defaults,
      'shared' => read_ini(File.join(ROOT, 'site.ini')),
      'env' => read_ini(File.join(ROOT, "#{env}.ini")),
      'local' => read_ini(File.join(ROOT, 'local.ini')),
      'process_env' => from_environ(defaults),
      'cli' => from_cli(argv)
    }
    merged = {}
    LAYERS.each do |layer|
      sources[layer].each do |key, value|
        next if LOCKED.include?(key) && ['process_env', 'cli'].include?(layer)

        merged[key] = value
      end
    end
    merged
  end
end
